newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tobishima says hopes to clarify position on report.
newsitem.headline: Tobishima says hopes to clarify position on report.

text.p: General contractor Tobishima Corp said it hoped to have a news conference or to release a statement on Friday to clarify its position on a Japanese media report that it had agreed a restructuring plan.
"We would like to have a news conference or to release a comment to clarify our stance about today's newspaper report," a Tobishima spokesman said.
He did not comment on the content of the report.
The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Friday that Fuji Bank Ltd and Tobishima, which is burdened by property-related debts, have agreed on a restructuring plan for Tobishima.
Tobishima Corp shares were bid-only at 431 yen at 0053 GMT against their Thursday close at 416 yen.
